ca_highway_62_crags.name: Highway 62 Crags
ca_highway_62_crags.note: HELD by reviewer: park-wide sources only, for crags outside the park. Sources name mid-Oct to late April/early May for Joshua Tree climbing (winter prime, summer too hot); no crag-specific page found, so park-wide window used.

ca_interstate_10_crags.name: Interstate 10 Crags
ca_interstate_10_crags.note: HELD by reviewer: park-wide sources only, for crags outside the park. Only park-wide Joshua Tree sources (Oct-Apr) found; lower, hotter desert so the cool-season window is the safe read; no crag-specific source.

nv_ice_box_canyon_bouldering.name: Ice Box Canyon Bouldering
nv_ice_box_canyon_bouldering.note: No source names months for these boulders; Icebox is shady, but sources conflict on whether that helps in summer or hurts in winter.

nv_icebox_canyon.name: Icebox Canyon
nv_icebox_canyon.note: MP: shady, 'good place to hide in warm weather'; forum: shade most of year, cold in April; Sunnyside Crags page says mostly sunny in summer, shady in winter. No month-naming source; sources conflict.

nv_juniper_canyon.name: Juniper Canyon
nv_juniper_canyon.note: Rainbow Wall (Juniper Canyon): spring and fall best per SummitPost, shady most of year per MP; forum names April and October, notes fall days are short.

nv_mt_wilson.name: Mt. Wilson
nv_mt_wilson.note: SummitPost (via search snippet, page itself 403) names spring and fall for Mt Wilson's long routes; forum cites April and October. MP page has no season text.
